newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed futures dip on new crop arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed futures dip on new crop arrivals.

text.p: Castorseed December delivery slid further to 1,082/1,083 rupees per quintal from 1,088/1,089 rupees on fresh speculative selling on Friday, dealers said.
"Sluggish overseas enquiries and rising new crop arrivals triggered fresh bull liquidation," a dealer said.

Volumes were low in December delivery ahead of crop maturity and the business will be gradually shifted to March delivery, he said. March delivery was nominally quoted at 1,140 rupees per quintal. Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region rose today to 10/12 thousand bags (75 kg each).
Groundnut oil on the other hand jumped to 357/358 rupees per 10 kg from 349/350 rupees on increased physical buying ahead of the wedding season and restricted new crop arrivals.
"State-owned agencies have started buying in the producing centres which in turn has curtailed arrivals of groundnut oil to the Bombay market," one miller said.
In Rajkot spot oil rose by five rupees to 340 rupees per 15 kg.
